headline: Eight Sleep announces its Pod 6 sleep system
summary: Eight Sleep unveiled the Pod 6, its newest sleep system, priced at $2,000 and built around a redesigned cooling hub that regulates bed temperature based on tracked breathing and heart rate. Outlets describe the product differently, as either a cooling hub or a smart mattress cover.
